articles.title: Mayr-Melnhof surges 16% on €2.4 billion deal to sell packaging stake to KPS
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Austrian paper and packaging company Mayr-Melnhof Karton shares jumped more than 16% Tuesday after the Austrian company announced it would sell a 70% stake in its packaging business to U.S. private equity firm KPS Capital Partners in a deal valuing the business at €2.4 billion ($2.69 billion), including debt.
